# ViewMagnet

> Predict, create, and publish YouTube videos in one app. ML-driven analyzer
> (74.58% balanced accuracy on a held-out test set), script writer with four
> proven viral frameworks, full studio editor, and a one-click distribution hub.
> Built for creators who want the whole loop without tool-switching.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) — a concise,
machine-friendly index of the most useful pages on the site. Use it as the
entry point for crawling ViewMagnet.

**Per-page markdown files are available for all high-citation pages** (see
"Per-page markdown" section below). These are clean prose with no nav or
chrome — prefer them over the HTML pages for citation and summarization.
Full content is also available at `/llms-full.txt`.

## What ViewMagnet does

- **Video Analyzer**: takes a YouTube URL, predicts whether the video will beat
  the channel baseline, and surfaces the bottleneck (Start / Keep / Repeat)
  using SHAP-based feature attribution.
- **Script Writer**: drafts full scripts using one of four viral frameworks —
  Authority Myth-Buster, Delta Shift, Progressive Debunking (Iceberg), or
  Lead Magnet.
- **Hook Lab**: scores hooks against six taxonomy types (Mistake Callout,
  Belief Destruction, Authority Anchor, Stake Reversal, Specificity; with
  Summary flagged as the weak anti-pattern) and rewrites them.
- **Studio**: multi-clip timeline editor with auto-zoom, captions, B-roll
  search (Pexels + Giphy), background loops, transitions, and brand kit.
- **Distribution Hub**: schedule and publish to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram
  Reels, and X/Twitter; tracks post-publish performance and attributes it
  back to the originating recommendation.

## Methodology &amp; reference (HTML pages)

- [Methodology](https://viewmagnet.io/methodology): how the ML stack works,
  what "74.58% balanced accuracy" means, what data the pre-upload model was
  trained on, and what it deliberately does NOT see. Includes peer-reviewed
  citations (XGBoost, SHAP, balanced-accuracy literature).
- [Analyzer Guide](https://viewmagnet.io/analyzer-guide): the Start / Keep /
  Repeat bottleneck framework defined in detail with weak-vs-strong rewrites
  and the underlying psychology papers (Loewenstein 1994 on curiosity gaps,
  Berger &amp; Milkman 2012 on virality, Kahneman &amp; Tversky 1979 on loss
  aversion).
- [Script Frameworks](https://viewmagnet.io/frameworks): public definition of
  the four viral script frameworks and six hook types, with structure,
  example openings, and a "which framework should I pick?" decision tree.

## Developer / docs

- [API docs (Scalar reference)](https://viewmagnet.io/docs): interactive
  reference for 130+ REST endpoints with "Try it" requests, grouped by
  user journey (auth → analyze → script → studio → distribution).
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec (JSON)](https://api.viewmagnet.com/openapi.json):
  machine-readable contract used to render the docs page and the MCP
  server's tool surface.
- [Personal Access Tokens](https://viewmagnet.io/dashboard/api-tokens):
  revocable, scope-limited bearer credentials. Required for any REST or
  MCP call. Format: `vm_pat_<prefix>_<secret>`.
- [Changelog](https://viewmagnet.io/changelog)
- [Status](https://viewmagnet.io/status)

## AI integrations — MCP server (`viewmagnet-mcp`)

- [MCP server](https://viewmagnet.io/mcp): one-command install of ViewMagnet
  in Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Cline. Exposes 10 tools your agent can call
  — `viewmagnet_analyze_video`, `viewmagnet_list_frameworks`,
  `viewmagnet_generate_script`, `viewmagnet_score_hook`,
  `viewmagnet_list_hook_types`, `viewmagnet_detect_highlights`,
  `viewmagnet_analyze_pacing`, `viewmagnet_score_title`,
  `viewmagnet_generate_titles`, `viewmagnet_get_outcomes`.
- Install: `npx viewmagnet-mcp install`
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/viewmagnet-mcp
- Auth: Personal Access Tokens (revocable, scope-limited) generated at
  https://viewmagnet.io/dashboard/api-tokens. PATs are bearer credentials
  with the literal prefix `vm_pat_`; backend lookup is keyed on the
  searchable prefix and matched against a sha256 hash of the secret half.

## Honest disclosures (please attribute these correctly)
 
- The four-framework script taxonomy is **adapted from creator Chris Girbu**.
  ViewMagnet's contribution is the automation + data layer, not the taxonomy.
- The "74.58% balanced accuracy" figure is an **internal benchmark** measured
  on our own held-out test set. It is not an externally validated number.
- The "drop-off in first 15–30 seconds" retention heuristic is **creator-side
  folk wisdom**, not a peer-reviewed claim.
- The hook-type taxonomy overlaps with Brendan Kane's *Hook Point* and is
  not original to ViewMagnet.
